bills.title: Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against the [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-10-08.104.1): > *That the [Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7245), the [Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Charges) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr7248%22) and the [Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr7246%22) be referred to the Standing Committee on Economics for consideration and an advisory report by 2 December 2024.* This motion was introduced by Fairfax MP [Ted O'Brien](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/wide_bay/llew_o'brien) (Liberal).
question: The majority voted against the [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-10-08.104.1): > *That the [Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7245), the [Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Charges) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr7248%22) and the [Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr7246%22) be referred to the Standing Committee on Economics for consideration and an advisory report by 2 December 2024.* This motion was introduced by Fairfax MP [Ted O'Brien](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/wide_bay/llew_o'brien) (Liberal).
